# How to read the tree {.unnumbered}

Every definition and [theorem](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/proof-writing.html#def-theorem) in these notes is one box, colored by kind.
A box sits below each definition and theorem it uses,
so the ones that use no others are at the top.
Hover over a box to see its name,
and click it to open its page.

::: {#dependency-graph-site}
:::

# With the prerequisites from math for computer science {.unnumbered}

These notes build on the
[math for computer science notes](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/dependency-tree.html),
whose Math Reference pages define sets, functions, numbers and proofs.
This tree joins both sets of notes:
a box sits below each definition and [theorem](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/proof-writing.html#def-theorem) it uses, in either one.
Hover over a box to see its name
and which notes it is in,
and click it to open its page.

::: {#dependency-graph-all data-json="https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/dependency-graph.json,https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/dependency-graph.json"}
:::
